en-US: Build 206 internal device test. Please check: open/edit/save/close Office files; open PDF and Office in the IDE internal tabs without losing the file tree; initialize a local Git repository without GitHub login; drag mind-map nodes freely, add child/sibling nodes with the icon controls, then undo and reopen; run consecutive shell commands and interactive input/EOF, cancel and run again; check that invalid background-service entries or ports produce a clear error. Office recovery copies are retained, but a genuinely failed document engine may still require restarting the App. Validation is limited to focused code checks and the cloud App build; physical-device acceptance is yours. Cross-task reading, local-model compaction and the new Linux/package architecture are still in progress and are not claimed fixed by this build.
zh-Hans: Build 206 内部真机测试。请重点测：Office 打开、修改、保存和关闭；在 IDE 内部标签打开 PDF／Office，文件树保持；未登录 GitHub 时初始化本地 Git 仓库；思维导图自由拖节点、用图标新增子级／同级、撤销并关闭重开；连续执行 Shell 命令、交互输入／EOF、取消后再执行；后台服务文件或端口无效时能得到明确错误。Office 恢复副本会保留，但文档引擎真正失败后仍可能需要重启 App。本轮只做定向代码检查和云端 App 构建，真机验收由你完成。跨任务读取、本地模型压缩及新的 Linux／安装架构仍在处理中，本包不宣称已经修好。
